messages:
amy: Hey @ops-oncall — customer reporting intermittent 500s on /v1/generate. They gave request_id=rid:cbf7a2e2 and said it happened around 2025-11-20T13:20:15Z (us-west-2). Can someone pull server-side logs?

ops-oncall: On it. Quick FYI: full request traces are retained ~21 days in prod, metrics longer. If the timestamp is >21d we may only have partial indexes. I'll try the query now.

nate-eng: Can you confirm the exact request_id string the customer pasted? sometimes they drop prefixes (rid: vs just cbf7a2e2). Also need the client timestamp and region — you already included region, thanks.

amy: They pasted exactly: rid:cbf7a2e2. Customer also shared their curl they used to repro: 

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-cust-XXXXX" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"Hello"}' 
  -w '\n%{http_code}\n' -s -D - -o /dev/null
```
They say it returned HTTP 500 and their client timestamp = 2025-11-20T13:20:15Z (PST) in us-west-2.

ops-oncall: Found matching lines. Query I used in Kibana: `request_id:"rid:cbf7a2e2" AND env:prod AND service:inference` then expanded to show `backend_error` and `trace_id`. Top result shows backend returned a 502/connection_reset at the same timestamp. Snippet from logs: `ERROR [inference.worker] backend connection reset by peer, trace=tr-8f3b`

julia-support: Can you ask the customer to run a quick verbose curl so we can confirm headers/timeouts? e.g. `curl -v ...` or ideally produce our debug bundle. Steps: ask them to call `POST /v1/debug-bundle` with the request_id in body, or if they can't, request a HAR from their browser or SDK debug logs.

mike-ops: Reminder: retention detail — event-level traces stored 21d in hot index, then archived for 90d in cold storage (searchable via internal archive tooling but slower). If this was >21d we may need archive retrieval. Also, recommend customers set `X-Request-Trace:true` header for long-term tracing to make lookups easier.

amy: Got it. I'll ask customer for verbose curl + the debug bundle request. Also will ask if they can reproduce and include `-v` output. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Search complete — 3 matching log events found for request_id=rid:cbf7a2e2 (prod/us-west-2). Internal link: https://logs.redwood.ai/app/kibana#/discover/abc123 (redacted) :eyes:

ops-oncall: I also pasted a short Splunk/ELK example query for future use: 

````
# Kibana/ES DSL example
GET /_search
{
  "query": {
    "bool": {
      "must": [
        { "term": { "request_id.keyword": "rid:cbf7a2e2" } },
        { "term": { "env": "prod" } }
      ]
    }
  },
  "sort": [{"@timestamp":{"order":"desc"}}]
}
````

amy: Sending repro instructions to customer now. I'll update here when they return the bundle or repro logs.
